chapter: On the road, Philadelphia and New York
title: Living in Philadelphia
summary: He had a house on Market Street in Philadelphia around 1953-54 and was separated from his wife.

blocks.x: So when did you get to Philadelphia-- was that in the early 50's?
Did you stay out there for a while?
Yeah, I had a house in Philly. I had a nice house in Phils, backyard.
No, well, separated, I'd put it. I'm still separated. But I had a nice place in Philadelphia on Market Street. And I stayed there for a while ---
